text:
Maya: Quick heads up — aiming to merge v2.1 docs by Thu 2026-03-26 EOD (cutoff for release). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4217 :eyes:

Leo: @Maya I can take the SDK snippets and smoke test examples today. Ping if CI flakes.

Maya: Need two approvals (docs + PM). @Sylvia can you take PM review? Also feature-flag gating: do NOT land user-facing content until `v2_1_public` is on prod or we include fallback text.

Sylvia: On it — booking a quick review at 10:30 PT.

Devon: Heads up, docs-preview bot has been flaky this week. Last preview timed out on assets. jekyll-build intermittently times out.

ci-bot: jekyll-build failed on PR #4217: timeout during asset compile. Re-run command: `./scripts/ci retry_pr 4217`. (reaction :warning:)

Leo: If preview doesn't arrive before cutoff we should still merge behind FF + `ff:hold` frontmatter. Also include a short migration note at the top so support has context.

Maya: Proposed migration snippet to include in upgrade guide:
```
If you're upgrading from v1.x -> v2.1:
- update config: `model: rwd/v2.1`
- remove legacy `batch_size` field
- check client SDK version >= 2.1.0
```

Leo: SDK quickstart snippet (JS) to add to top of quickstart page:
```js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.generate({ model: 'rwd/v2.1', prompt: 'Hello' });
```

Devon: tagging @eng-lead in case we need an override for emergency merge after cutoff.

eng-lead: Prefer we avoid emergency merges unless GA is blocked. If preview bot fails, merge with `docs-reviewed` label + `ff:hold` metadata; ops will toggle flag post-release.

Maya: OK. I'll add `ff:hold` frontmatter and request two approvals. If CI goes green and preview appears, I'll remove `ff:hold` before the actual merge.

Sylvia: Approved the PM copy. :thumbsup:

Leo: Approved from SDK side. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Re-running CI now. If green I'll request merge slot for Thu 2026-03-26 18:00 UTC.

ci-bot: Re-run started for PR #4217 — jekyll-build, linkcheck, spellcheck queued.

ci-bot: All checks passed on PR #4217 — jekyll-build, linkcheck, spellcheck.

Maya: Adding `docs-reviewed` label and scheduling merge slot 2026-03-26T18:00:00Z. @deploy-bot please ensure canary docs link is available for final sanity check.

deploy-bot: Canary site will refresh at 17:45 UTC; preview link: https://docs-canary.redwood.ai/v2.1/4217 (reaction :rocket:)

Maya: Thanks — post-merge follow-ups: QA migration checklist, notify support with snippet, update changelog and release notes.

Leo: I'll prepare the SDK patch release note and example repo update.

Sylvia: I'll notify PMs and change ownership on the migration doc. Done.

Maya: If anything pops up before 18:00 UTC call out here. Otherwise merging at slot. :rocket:
